```{r}
data_dir <- '.../Das_Alyona__BT2015050_2015_A1/outs'
seurat_object_sp_stage2 <- Load10X_Spatial(
  data_dir, #directory containing the H5 file specified by filename and the image data in a subdirectory called spatial
  filename = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5", #name of H5 file containing the feature barcode matrix
  assay = "Spatial", #name of the initial assay
  slice = "Stage 2", #name for the stored image of the tissue slice
  filter.matrix = TRUE, #only keep spots that have been determined to be over tissue
  to.upper = FALSE,
  image = NULL, #name of image to pull the coordinates from
)
if (FALSE) {
  data_dir <- 'path/to/data/directory'
  list.files(data_dir) # Should show filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5
  Load10X_Spatial(data.dir = data_dir)
}
```

```{r}
#data pre-processing
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^MT-") #mit genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL") #ribo genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^HB[^(P)]") #hb genes
seurat_object_sp_stage2[["percent.mbp"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object_sp_stage2, pattern = "^MBP")
plot1 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "nCount_Spatial", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot2 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot3 <-VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.ribo", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot4 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.hb", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot5 <- VlnPlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "percent.mbp", pt.size = 0.1) + NoLegend()
plot6 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(seurat_object_sp_stage2, features = "nCount_Spatial") + theme(legend.position = "right")
wrap_plots(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, plot5, plot6)
```

```{r}

seurat_object_sp_stage4$orig.ident <- "Grade 4"
patient.merge <- merge(
  seurat_object_sp_stage2,
  y = c(seurat_object_sp_stage3, seurat_object_sp_stage4),
  merge.data = TRUE,
  add.cell.ids = c("Grade2", "Grade3", "Grade4")
)
```

```{r}
patient.merge <- RunUMAP(patient.merge, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
```

```{r}
library(grid)

add_visium_scale_bar <- function(plot, seurat_obj, image_name, 
                                 distance_um = 500) {
  
  # extract scale factors
  sf <- seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@scale.factors
  
  # calculate spot size in image pixels
  spot_pixels <- sf$spot * sf$hires
  
  # Visium spot diameter ≈ 55 µm
  pixels_per_um <- spot_pixels / 55
  
  # scale bar length in pixels
  bar_pixels <- distance_um * pixels_per_um
  
  # image dimensions
  img_dim <- dim(seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@image)
  img_width <- img_dim[2]
  
  # convert pixels to relative coordinates
  bar_fraction <- bar_pixels / img_width
  
  # bottom-left position
  x_start <- 0.08
  x_end <- x_start + bar_fraction
  
  y_bar <- 0.06
  y_text <- 0.085
  
  plot +
    annotation_custom(
      segmentsGrob(
        x0 = x_start,
        x1 = x_end,
        y0 = y_bar,
        y1 = y_bar,
        gp = gpar(lwd = 2)
      )
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      textGrob(
        paste0(distance_um, " µm"),
        x = (x_start + x_end)/2,
        y = y_text,
        gp = gpar(
          fontsize = 8
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(grid)

add_visium_scale_bar <- function(plot, seurat_obj, image_name,
                                 distance_um = 500) {

  sf <- seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@scale.factors

  spot_pixels <- sf$spot * sf$hires

  pixels_per_um <- spot_pixels / 55

  bar_pixels <- distance_um * pixels_per_um

  img_dim <- dim(seurat_obj@images[[image_name]]@image)
  img_width <- img_dim[2]

  bar_fraction <- bar_pixels / img_width

  # bottom left
  x_start <- 0.08
  x_end <- x_start + bar_fraction

  y_bar <- 0.06
  y_text <- 0.085

  plot +
    annotation_custom(
      segmentsGrob(
        x0 = x_start,
        x1 = x_end,
        y0 = y_bar,
        y1 = y_bar,
        gp = gpar(lwd = 1.5)
      )
    ) +
    annotation_custom(
      textGrob(
        paste0(distance_um, " µm"),
        x = (x_start + x_end) / 2,
        y = y_text,
        gp = gpar(fontsize = 7)
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
stage3_svgs <- SpatiallyVariableFeatures(Grade3)
stage4_svgs <- SpatiallyVariableFeatures(Grade4)

write.csv(stage2_svgs, "Grade2_spatially_variable_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stage3_svgs, "Grade3_spatially_variable_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stage4_svgs, "Grade4_spatially_variable_genes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#enrichment analysis
# Load the packages
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ReactomePA)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
head(stage4_markers)
sig_genes <- rownames(stage4_markers[stage4_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05, ])
```
```{r}
enrichment4 <- enrichGO(gene         = sig_genes,
                        OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
                        keyType      = "SYMBOL",
                        ont          = "BP",
                        minGSSize    = 50,
                        pAdjustMethod = "BH")
```

```{r}
head(enrichment4, n=10)
```

```{r}
# Visualize the top enriched GO terms
dotplot(enrichment4, showCategory = 10, title = "GO Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```

```{r}
#KEGG Pathway Enrichment
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs for KEGG analysis
sig_genes_entrez <- bitr(sig_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)$ENTREZID
```

```{r}
# KEGG pathway enrichment for upregulated genes
kegg_up <- enrichKEGG(gene = sig_genes_entrez, 
                      organism = "hsa", 
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```
```{r}
head(kegg_up, n=10)
# Visualize KEGG pathway results
dotplot(kegg_up, showCategory = 10, title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```
```{r}
# Reactome pathway enrichment for upregulated genes
reactome_up <- enrichPathway(gene = sig_genes_entrez, 
                             organism = "human", 
                             pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```
```{r}

```

```{r}
# Visualize Reactome pathways
head(reactome_up, n=10)
dotplot(reactome_up, showCategory = 10, title = "Reactome Pathway Enrichment for Upregulated Genes")
```
